quarterly_data.signal: GROSS-MARGIN PATH REITERATED (NO GUIDANCE UPDATE), AND THE 43.5% MODEL IS NOT A CEILING: CFO Paul Oldham restated that last quarter AE said it expects gross margins 'to exit this current year around 42%, and next year around 43%', a path that already includes the cost of bringing Thailand and the other manufacturing investments on stream. He named tariffs (not in the original model) and the more data-center-heavy mix as the headwinds, said margins are improving in all markets including data center, and said most of the new-product mix benefit is still ahead: 'while we put out a model that said 43.5%, we think we can certainly go beyond that'.
quarterly_data.figure: exit this current year around 42%; next year around 43%; 43.5% model, can go beyond
